purpose: Bounded physical feasibility witness independent of candidate RRT search success.
physical_scene_mutation: none after the matched setup; same scene/start/goal as candidate trial
success_requirements: all three full-pose requests reached with original effective tolerances
zero reported PhysX contact points for strict witness
no cooked whole-arm/hand obstacle intersection at sampled states
independent references include physical fixture and support geometry
no robot joint teleports or changes to physical joint drives
failure_policy: Retain failed witness and report scene feasibility unproven; do not retune height, fixtures, controller or tolerances to manufacture success.
limitations: A successful physical witness establishes one sampled feasible traversal, not a proof of the entire continuous joint trajectory or arbitrary seeds.
A failed DirectRmpflow witness cannot prove the physical scene is impossible.
The manual path is evaluation context and never input to the candidate RRT planner.
Positive-separation reports and measured penetration/impulse remain separately recorded; strict zero-report criterion is unchanged.
